interpretation.interpretation:
This is a standalone interpretation and closure note for the stopped autonomous supplement, authored under the versioned evidence-bound reporting repair. It states only what the retained ledger supports, and it does not retroactively correct any earlier text: earlier statements remain as written, and closure of this report depends on this versioned post-run repair artifact rather than on a silent rewrite of prior prose.

Why the run stopped. The stop is sealed, and its recorded reason is that the complete-delivery reservation was insufficient. In the usage ledger the backend solve allowance is fully consumed with none remaining, so no further complete search could be reserved. Read plainly, that is exhausted backend capacity for another complete search -- not a reporting-cost decision, and not a scientific failure of the evaluated behavior. Model-call, tool-call and clock budget remained, which is why a post-run reporting repair could still be authored at all.

How to read the ledger. The packet carries two structure identities and two inherited group labels (original and shortened). The scope note attached to the structure definitions states that physical dimensions and identity are authoritative, and it expressly disclaims that the labels assert a length ordering between the groups. This report therefore makes no length-ranking claim from those labels.

An original-geometry matching-weight pass. Exactly one execution on the original structure carries the same holding-and-terminal weighting pair as the retained incumbent, and it satisfies terminal reach, holding position, holding speed and the joint reach-and-holding condition together in that original geometry. That is a direct counterexample to any reading in which the shortened geometry is what enabled passing, and it is the concrete artifact behind the geometry-attribution failure cause. The original geometry is not uniformly failing: several other original-structure executions pass terminal reach while failing the holding conditions, so the single matching-weight pass is the point of note rather than a uniform original-geometry outcome.

Historical shortened-geometry passes. Within the shortened structure exactly two historical joint passes exist -- the retained incumbent and one other historical configuration observed in the frozen pre-experiment background. Both are historical. Claiming further shortened-geometry historical passes besides the incumbent would overcount, and the other historical pass is not a new candidate.

The single new passing point. Exactly one updated-campaign execution attains the joint reach-and-holding condition, so the new pass is described in the singular. Its trade-off against the retained incumbent is real and is a trade-off, not a domination: it reaches a smaller holding maximum speed -- a tighter speed margin -- while carrying a larger terminal error and a larger holding maximum position error, and its mean complete update time is larger than the incumbent's. It is a candidate to weigh, not a strict improvement, and the incumbent is not displaced.

Replication. The repeat is an updated-campaign execution of an earlier frozen shortened-geometry scientific configuration. Only the three retained aggregate metrics repeat exactly: terminal error, holding maximum error and holding maximum speed are equal between source and repeat. The recorded comparison scope covers only those aggregate metrics, so nothing there reaches trajectories or timing. Timing in particular does not repeat, because the repeat records a larger mean complete update time than its source, and the repeat does not itself attain the joint condition. This supports partial confirmation of those aggregate metrics only -- not general repeatability, variance, identical trajectories or identical timing.

Timing and status fields. Timing partitions with geometry: the shorter update times occur in the shortened cluster and the longer ones in the original cluster, and within the shortened cluster the retained incumbent sits in its faster portion while the latest execution is the slowest of that cluster and slower than the incumbent. Control period, control update count and deadline misses are identical across the ledger; real-time demonstration is not achieved in any execution; solver errors and force-bound violations are absent throughout.

Four historical failure causes, kept distinct. The recorded causes differ in kind: a prior connection refusal; an incompatible required tool choice while thinking was in force; an original-geometry pass attributed to the shortened geometry; and a terminal metric attributed across execution identifiers although the correct source was retained in the ledger. The first two are interface- and client-level conditions outside the report text. The geometry-attribution and numerical-attribution faults are reporting errors authored in the model's own text -- a wrong geometry selection, and a metric reference rendered against the wrong execution identifier -- and the corrected reference is simply the fact the ledger already held. Separately, the earlier compact input omitted the physical component definitions of the structures; that omission is an evidence-projection defect and is treated only as a possible contributor to the campaign's reporting difficulties, not as a proven internal mechanism and not as a demonstrated cause of the scientific campaign's difficulties. The present packet does carry component dimensions, sections and physics for both structures, which is a projection repair rather than a causal claim.

Scope, STOPs and closure. No scientific work is requested or performed here, and every scientific STOP is preserved as recorded: this artifact is a reporting-level, post-run repair only. The multibatch scientific behavior passed originally, whereas factual reporting passes only through this reviewed versioned repair; closure is therefore conditional on it, and it does not reach back to fix earlier text. The standing limitations hold: one matching repeat does not establish general repeatability, variance, identical trajectories or identical timing, and sampled acceptance does not establish a continuous-time guarantee, realtime, superiority or a unique physical cause. Because the stop was capacity exhaustion, any further complete search would need a freshly reserved backend allowance rather than a reporting change.
interpretation.recommendation: Retain the retained incumbent as the incumbent, and read the latest updated-campaign execution as a later configuration that does not attain the joint condition. Treat the single new updated-campaign joint pass and the one other historical shortened joint pass as trade-off candidates rather than replacements: each buys a tighter holding speed margin at the cost of a larger terminal error and a larger holding position error. Keep the original-structure matching-weight pass as the standing counterexample that keeps geometry attribution honest. Accept the repeated scientific configuration as partial confirmation of the three retained aggregate metrics only, and do not extend it to trajectories, timing, variance or general repeatability. Keep the four historical causes separate, describing the geometry-attribution and numerical-attribution faults as reporting errors in the model's own text, and the omitted component definitions as a possible evidence-projection contributor rather than a proven internal mechanism. File this versioned post-run repair as the closure artifact for this report without rewriting earlier text, and treat closure as conditional on it. Do not request scientific work, and note that any further complete search would require a freshly reserved backend capacity rather than a reporting change.
unresolved: Whether the newer joint-pass trade-offs are preferable to the retained incumbent under the intended objective is unresolved.

Whether the evidence-projection defect contributed causally to the reporting errors is unresolved; it remains a possible contributor only, and the geometry-attribution and numerical-attribution faults are treated as reporting errors rather than proven internal mechanisms.
General repeatability, variance, trajectory identity and timing identity remain unresolved beyond the single aggregate-metric repeat.
Continuous-time, realtime and uniqueness guarantees remain outside what the sampled acceptance evidence can establish.
Whether the inherited group labels imply a physical length ordering remains unresolved; labels alone do not establish order.
Whether a further complete search should be reserved at all is unresolved, and it would require fresh reserved backend capacity rather than a reporting change.
